import { attachControl, setCameraLimits } from "@babylonjs/lite";

type RadiusLimits = {
  lowerRadiusLimit?: number | undefined;
  upperRadiusLimit?: number | undefined;
};

  canvas: HTMLCanvasElement,
  scene: SceneContext,
  minDistance: number,

  let disposed = false;
  return () => {
    if (disposed) return;
    disposed = true;
    disposeControls();

}
